name: Azekah
line: Azekah was a city of Judah in the low hills, where God sent hailstones on fleeing enemies and where Babylon's army later fought against Judah.

moments.title: Hailstones on the road to Azekah
moments.text: As the Amorite armies fled from Israel, the LORD cast down large hailstones on them along the descent from Beth-horon to Azekah. More of them died from the hailstones than from the swords of the Israelites.

moments.title: Philistines camp near Azekah
moments.text: The Philistines gathered for war at Socoh in Judah and camped between Socoh and Azekah. Israel stood across the valley from them.

moments.title: Babylon fights against Azekah
moments.text: Babylon's army was fighting against Jerusalem, Lachish, and Azekah. These were the only cities with strong defenses still left in Judah.
